about: One reading of time in both languages (DATA-R92, LOG-R48, LOG-R50): each case is a condition spec's time-based fields, a naive realm date-time and whether the spec is open then. scripts/tests/test_realm_time.py reads it against the generator's evaluator, spec/Pagle/logic/TimeSpecs_spec.lua against Core's MatchesConditions and NextWindow. rules are the event list's weekly rules (DATA-R38; weekday 1 is Sunday); 303 has none, so it is never open. 2026-02-28 is a Saturday, 2026-03-01 a Sunday, 2028-02-29 a Tuesday.
